description: This Java class 'ConfigDefinition' processes configuration files for a larger software project. It reads a specific text-based configuration input file, parses its content including structures, defines, and custom settings, and generates corresponding output files such as C header files, typeScript project files, and Java field definitions. It also manages variable substitutions and textual templates for generating configuration artifacts.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, handling command-line arguments, coordinating file processing and generating output artifacts.

methods.name: processTextTemplate
methods.description: Reads a text template file, applies variable substitutions, and writes the processed content to an output file.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads and processes configuration input line by line, handling structures, definitions, custom values, bits, and fields via callbacks to consumers.

methods.name: handleCustomLine
methods.description: Processes custom configuration lines, extracting name, size, and associated variable line, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: handleBitLine
methods.description: Parses bit field lines, creating ConfigField objects for bit definitions within a structure.

methods.name: startsWithToken
methods.description: Utility to check if a line begins with a specific token followed by space or tab.

methods.name: handleStartStructure
methods.description: Begins a new structure context, pushing a ConfigStructure onto the stack.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Closes the current structure, adds alignment fill, stores it in the structure map, and calls consumers' end-struct handling.

methods.name: processField
methods.description: Parses a line defining a configuration field and adds it to the current structure, supporting iterations.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Generates a comment string with offset information for documentation.

methods.name: packComment
methods.description: Formats a block comment for documentation with proper line prefixes.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size value for a string, whether it is an integer literal or a variable reference.

methods.name: processDefine
methods.description: Parses macro definitions and registers them in the variable registry.
